topic: Will we be able to predict catastrophic weather events more accurately?
scientific_reframe: How much can an event-aware, physics-informed forecasting and early-warning system improve probabilistic skill, calibration, warning lead time, and false-alarm control for tropical cyclones, tsunamis, and earthquakes under hazard-specific predictability limits?
primary_gap: Operational prediction, early warning, uncertainty calibration, and impact decisions are not evaluated as one latency-constrained chain.
recommended_direction: MULTIHAZARD-X: hazard-specific state-transition modules with shared uncertainty and decision-calibration layers.
required_boundaries: earthquake exact prediction versus forecast and early warning
sequential tsunami warning after source initiation
weather forecast skill versus impact warning utility
